# mysql

```go
import "github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/stores/mysql"
```

Package mysql is the MySQL state\-store backend for blkit: a durable, shareable store keeping each run's ProcessState in MySQL, built on the go\-sql\-driver/mysql driver via database/sql. See specs/stores/mysql\-state\-store.spec.md.

## type [Config](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/stores/mysql/store.go#L20-L23>)

Config holds the construction parameters for the MySQL backend.

```go
type Config struct {
    DSN         string // go-sql-driver DSN, e.g. "user:pass@tcp(host:3306)/blkit"; required
    TablePrefix string // table-name prefix; defaults to "blkit_"
}
```

<a name="New"></a>
### func [New](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/stores/mysql/store.go#L42>)

```go
func New(cfg Config) *Store
```

New parses the DSN (forcing ParseTime and UTC so DATETIME(6) columns round\-trip as UTC time.Time values) and opens the pool lazily. Following the blkit constructor convention it panics on an invalid config.

<a name="Store.CurrentVersion"></a>
### func (\*Store) [CurrentVersion](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/stores/mysql/store.go#L249>)

```go
func (s *Store) CurrentVersion(runID string) (*bl.CurrentVersion, error)
```

CurrentVersion returns the latest committed value per (task, field) via a ROW\_NUMBER window. Returns (nil, nil) for an unknown run.

<a name="Store.Flush"></a>
### func (\*Store) [Flush](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/stores/mysql/store.go#L208>)

```go
func (s *Store) Flush(runID string) error
```

Flush is a no\-op beyond confirming the transaction committed: writes are synchronous once WriteBatch returns.

<a name="Store.FullHistory"></a>
### func (\*Store) [FullHistory](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/stores/mysql/store.go#L289>)

```go
func (s *Store) FullHistory(runID string) (*bl.FullHistory, error)
```

FullHistory returns every stored record for the run in replay order (ts, id). Returns (nil, nil) for an unknown run.

<a name="Store.WriteBatch"></a>
